test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 7800 amounts to Rs. 10381.80 at *x*% p.a. in 2 years when the interest is compounded 8-monthly. What will be the compound interest on the same sum at (*x* + 5)% p.a. in one year, if the interest is compounded half yearly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Amount** to **Principal** for 3 periods (24/8 = 3): A/P = 10381.80 / 7800 = 1.331.

For n = 3, 1 + r = ³√1.331 = 1.1 ⇒ 8-monthly rate (r) = 10%.

Annual rate **x** = 10% × (12 / 8) = 15%. New annual rate = 15% + 5% = **20%**.

Compounded **half-yearly** for 1 year (2 periods): Rate = 10% per period.

Effective interest rate = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10 / 100) = 21%.

**Compound Interest** = 21% of 7800 = 78 × 21 = ₹1638.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1638.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Principal (P) = ₹7800, Amount (A) = ₹10381.80, Time = 2 years, Compounding = 8-monthly.

**Formula Used:** A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ; CI = P[(1 + r/100)ⁿ − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c2a0e123a19366692c93ee1091f90c10a8bde54673b925c0223c141e851c468.png] 

⇒ Number of periods (n) = (2 × 12) / 8 = 3 periods.

⇒ 10381.80 = 7800 (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 10381.80 / 7800 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 1.331 = (1 + r/100)³ ⇒ (1.1)³ = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ r/100 = 0.1 ⇒ r = 10% (Rate for 8 months).

⇒ Annual rate x = (10 / 8) × 12 = 15% p.a.

⇒ New rate = x + 5 = 15 + 5 = 20% p.a.

⇒ For **half-yearly compounding**: New r = 20 / 2 = 10%; n = 1 × 2 = 2.

⇒ CI = 7800 [(1 + 10/100)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 7800 [1.21 − 1] = 7800 × 0.21 = ₹1638.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1638.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

When interest is compounded more than once a year, the effective rate is given by Rₑff = [ (1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1 ] × 100, where n is the number of compounding periods.

Compounding Frequency Rule

For a period of T years and annual rate R%, if interest is compounded every 'k' months: New Rate = R × (k/12) and New Time = (T × 12)/k.

Successive Percentage Method

For 2 periods at r%, the total compound interest percentage is r + r + (r×r)/100.
